content: Hmm?

content: I think Rhodes Island will confront him directly, so that whole secret search is unlikely to succeed.

content: Milady, I want to know why you're doing this. If you give me a reasonable answer, I won't go after Rhodes Island.

content: ...This is something I have to do. I don't believe that my father is such a cold-blooded person. He would never stand by idly and let this happen.

speaker: Ceylon
content: My father loves this city more than anyone else. And I know that better than anyone else.

speaker: Schwarz
content: Do you still hate him?

speaker: Ceylon
content: Why would I? If anything, he should be the one who hates me, because my birth took my mother's life...

speaker: Ceylon
content: But he never resented me.

raw: [name="Ceylon"]   What I hate is how he arranges everything for me and never tells me what he's planning.
speaker: Ceylon
content: What I hate is how he arranges everything for me and never tells me what he's planning.

content: Just like right now! It must be Cronin's fault; he must have hidden the truth about the eruption from my father.

content: That's the only reason he ordered Cronin to stop me! Would you call that hate?

content: Eruption?

content: Don't worry about it.

speaker: Schwarz
content: ...Hmm, I see what is going on now.

content: So Cronin wasn't even under my father's orders when he tried to capture me. Phew, that about clears things up.

content: Schwarz, if I really wanted to do something like that, I would have gone through legal channels.

content: I understand. Milady, you're not concerned about the past, or about social standings.

content: I feel the same way as you. As does your father.

speaker: Ceylon
content: Phew... No matter what others think, I'll always trust you and my father.

content: Even if there's a conflict between our goals, I trust that we'll be able to resolve things between the two of us.

speaker: Ceylon
content: That's why you'd come to stop me.

content: Come to think of it, it doesn't really matter who the mayor is, right? I'm sure that's what my father would think. What he cares about is this city.
